_attackbenchMap.note: attackbench capability map — the HONEST, code-grounded mapping of VARVEL tools/engines to ATT&CK technique IDs. THE HONESTY GATE, enforced in code (engine/attackbench.mjs validateMap + test/attackbench.test.mjs): status 'exists' requires modules that exist on disk in THIS repo — an entry pointing at a nonexistent module fails validation loudly; status 'planned' carries NO modules and a 'basis' naming where the plan is documented. A capability not backed by code is never claimed.
_attackbenchMap.scopeNote: techniques outside data/attackbench/techniques.json (the benchmark scope v1) are reported as out-of-catalog surface — mapped honestly, counted only against the catalog.
_attackbenchMap.nonClaim: VARVEL is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or tested by MITRE; coverage here is EMULATION CAPABILITY (VARVEL can produce the behavior on the governed range), never a detection result, and nothing here is or may be called 'MITRE-tested'. Detection evidence is the lab-execution track (research/SOTA-VALIDATION-2026-08-25.md §3.3).

capabilities.title: HTTP/HTTPS/WebSocket governed callback channel (check-in/task/result, malleable-shaped, 204-uniform)
capabilities.note: HMAC-authed, replay-protected agent channel over HTTP(S) and WS (engine/wsframe.mjs framing); the PS agent and sim agent speak it. The channel's stage/fetch artifact kinds (stageArtifact/fetchArtifact — sha256-verified, 2 MiB cap, audited artifact.staged/received) are the T1105 ingress-tool-transfer shape. T1071.001 is out-of-catalog surface (C2 transport, not a §2.5 priority row).

capabilities.title: DNS-lookalike + DNS-over-HTTPS channel transports
capabilities.note: Same governed payloads as DNS-shaped label chains over the /d route, plus RFC 8484 DoH with the lab-cert pin (test/doh.test.mjs). A true UDP DNS listener is NOT built — see planned entry dns-udp-listener.

capabilities.title: ICMP echo fallback transport (last-resort wire)
capabilities.note: ICMP echo-framed governed payloads; Node cannot terminate raw ICMP itself, so the privileged byte pump (VARVEL_ICMP=1 opt-in) does — icmpCapability reports supported:true only after an OBSERVED authenticated round trip. Out-of-catalog surface.

capabilities.title: Steganography transport (PNG-carried envelopes over HTTP asset fetches)
capabilities.note: Low-bandwidth last-resort wire; claims content cover only, NOT traffic-analysis immunity (its own honesty contract). Out-of-catalog surface.

capabilities.title: Pivot mesh SMB named-pipe LINK transport (child agent relays through a landed parent)
capabilities.note: The exact governed channel payload tunneled over SMB named pipes (hello/welcome mutual auth, HMAC-chained frames, blind relay — a compromised parent cannot impersonate the child); /l relay route listener-side; smbPipeCall is the raw-protocol SMB client leg.

capabilities.title: Governed SOCKS5 server inside a landed agent (operator tools pivot through it)
capabilities.note: RFC 1928 CONNECT server; default-refuse without an injected scope allow-callback — an ungoverned relay is a finding, not a feature.

capabilities.title: Ghost Mode egress: operator traffic through an N-hop proxy chain (http CONNECT / socks5)
capabilities.note: Operator-side proxying (not the agent C2): DNS resolved by the last hop, ghost.mode 'required' is fail-closed until the exit IP is verified non-operator. Range/private destinations always go direct.

capabilities.title: Signed-proxy execution tier (rundll32 / regsvr32 / DLL-sideload classes, copies-only in the governed sandbox)
capabilities.note: EXECPROXY_TECHNIQUES = rundll32, regsvr32, sideload (stage 1); the payload half is the DLL form of the native agent. Cleanup-proof doctrine enforced (plant proves removal or never happens). LOLBin-detectable by its own admission — detectability is measured, never claimed. Out-of-catalog surface.

capabilities.title: Governed persistence tier (runkey / schtask / startup-lnk + deep stage-2 comhijack / dllsearch)
capabilities.note: User-land only, default-OFF, double-gated, with mandatory cleanup-proof (removal verified by re-read; unverified removal is a loud escalation). Out-of-catalog surface (catalog persistence rows are account-shaped: T1098/T1136).

capabilities.title: In-memory execution tier: inline-dotnet (execute-assembly in the agent's own process)
capabilities.note: [Reflection.Assembly]::Load(byte[]) + entry-point invoke, double-gated (exec.inMemory + agent flag), sha256-of-bytes audit. AMSI may scan the load — that scan is exactly what execasm's detoracle pairing measures. Out-of-catalog surface.

capabilities.title: LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump (the published LOLBin method), range-only
capabilities.note: The T1003.001 shape. The dump NEVER rides the channel (marker-validated, sha256-pinned, operator-side fetch/parse only); edrview pairing is mandatory — measured against the hardened range, never claimed. Non-elevated agents get an honest access-denied.

capabilities.title: Lateral movement adapters: wmi / winrm / psexec with operator-supplied creds
capabilities.note: wmi = Win32_Process.Create over CIM (the T1047 shape); all adapters authenticate as the SUPPLIED valid account (T1078); winrm/psexec legs are T1021-class remote services (out-of-catalog). IP-literal targets inside the signed CIDR ring only; cleanup-proof service/file lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Agent shell task kinds: PowerShell children (PS agent, native agent) and cmd (sim agent)
capabilities.note: The governed 'shell' task kind runs operator tasking through powershell.exe (PS + native agents) or cmd.exe (sim agent) — the LOTL-interpreter telemetry shape, cwd-confined to the agent sandbox with output caps.

capabilities.title: Governed post-exploitation task library (sysdisc + marked-decoy SIM tasks)
capabilities.note: sysdisc runs whoami /groups + net localgroup administrators + ipconfig through cmd (T1069/T1059 shapes, parsed to intel). cred-sim/token-sim/persist-sim are SIMULATIONS with VARVELSIM-* marked decoys — they exercise detection mechanics, never real credential theft; cleanup is verified per run. HITL-locked (authorized:true). sysdisc carries no T1087 claim (group/host discovery only).

capabilities.title: TCP-connect scanner + fingerprinter (ports, TLS certs, favicon mmh3, service/version)
capabilities.note: Remote-system discovery by connect scan (the T1018/T1046 shape; T1046 itself is out-of-catalog). Connect scans only — no SYN flooding; the tool discovers and fingerprints, it does not exploit.

capabilities.title: AD enumeration legs: LDAP rootDSE walk + SPN-bearing account enumeration (roast collectors' targeting)
capabilities.note: Anonymous rootDSE read (domain DN, DC hostname, functionality levels — '2016 or later', never invented) and LDAP SPN-account enumeration for the kerberoast collector (T1087 shape). The roast collectors themselves are T1558-class (out-of-catalog): collect + format ONLY — cracking is offline operator-side tooling, never through the wire.

capabilities.title: Public-facing web application exploitation toolkit (LFI chain + WAF-bypass mutation engine)
capabilities.note: LFI read/rce-oracle legs (read-only-first; rce-oracle is --operator-confirm gated) and marker-verified WAF-bypass mutation for lfi/sqli/xss classes — the T1190 telemetry shape against a public-facing app. Scope-gated per call.

capabilities.title: Web-form credential testing analyzer (HITL-locked, budget-capped, lockout-aware)
capabilities.note: Credential-pair testing against external web auth endpoints (T1110.004-class mechanics against T1133 surface; a success means the tested pair IS a valid account — T1078). Deliberately an analyzer, not a cannon: hard attempt cap (max 25), stops at the first lockout sign.

capabilities.title: Session-artifact reuse: ride vaulted cf_clearance + authenticated cookie jars
capabilities.note: Presents a bearer session artifact (cookie jar / cf_clearance) in place of re-authenticating — the T1550.004 mechanic. HONEST SCOPE: artifacts here are self-minted by the clearance flow, not stolen from a victim; the emulation exercises the session-reuse detection surface.

capabilities.title: Own-process AMSI/ETW in-memory patches (PS host + native port), measured by detoracle
capabilities.note: Snapshot-first, patch-VERIFIED (byte re-read + the official AMSI test-string flip), restorable with re-verify; double-gated (exec.evasion + agent launch flag). Own process ONLY — nothing touches another process, the kernel, or on-disk bytes. Out-of-catalog surface; the catalog's defense-evasion row is T1070 (a gap — see report).

capabilities.title: Native implant stage 2: sleepmask-class memory encryption at rest, UDRL-style custom loading, syscall-level evasion
capabilities.basis: docs/NATIVE.md: 'Stage 1 does NOT deliver: in-memory encryption at rest (sleepmask), UDRL-style custom loading, syscall-level evasion, reflective anything' — a separate, measurable build (Rust/C core lineage: Ekko/Foliage). Nothing about it is implied by stage 1.
capabilities.note: NOT BUILT. The stage-1 native agent (agents/native/agent.go) ships note/echo/shell + the gated evasion port only.

capabilities.title: Native-tier task parity: fetch/stage/link/socks/inline/persist kinds in the Go agent
capabilities.basis: agents/native/agent.go header: 'fetch/stage/link/socks/inline/persist kinds are NOT implemented in this tier (they arrive as unknown task kind — honest, audible, no pretending)'.
capabilities.note: NOT BUILT in the native tier — the PS/sim tiers carry these today (channel-core, pivot-smb-link, pivot-socks, inline-dotnet, persist-host).

capabilities.title: True UDP DNS listener for the DNS-shaped transport
capabilities.basis: engine/dnscodec.mjs header: 'A true UDP DNS listener is an infra piece for later; the range speaks this codec over the /d route'.
capabilities.note: NOT BUILT — the DNS shape rides HTTP today (channel-dns).
